'If you find this, please tell me if the sea ends somewhere,' it said, and it gave an address in Nova Scotia dated eleven years earlier. He told the child, now surely grown, that the sea does end, at every shore, and that someone is always watching it.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没醒来。路灯把空荡荡的街道染成昏黄色，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，轮胎碾过积水，声音传得很远。便利店的灯一直亮着，店员趴在柜台上打盹。高楼大多黑着，只有零星几扇窗还透出光，也许有人在加班，也许有人失眠。环卫工人推着车慢慢走，扫帚划过地面，沙沙作响。东边的天空开始泛出一点灰白，早班公交亮着车灯停在站台，等待第一位乘客。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a big problem by using itself on a smaller piece of the same problem.\n- It keeps making the problem smaller until it reaches a piece so tiny the answer is obvious, called the base case.\n- Then all the small answers combine back into the big answer, like opening nested boxes until you reach the last tiny one, then closing them all again."}
